spine.deviation_notes: Life-as-resource lands on the purpose-built RS/LC lane (reservation_resource=hp + hp_cost_scale — the engine even names the guard after this kit). Minor identity drift: PoE Blood Magic is TOTAL and uncapped (max mana=0, any cost can exceed your life), engine clamps to 0.30 max-HP/cast LOCKED and keeps a mana pool. The 'no safety rail, cast can kill you' danger that defines the keystone's feel is bounded by the guard. Keystone-not-active-skill => geometry is a degenerate placeholder.

mapping_json.motion_frame: resource-identity keystone: mana is deleted; life pays every cost and every reservation; the player manages the life pool against recovery instead of a mana bar

economy: reservation_resource=hp (auras/reserves draw from life, per RS/LC lane)
hp_cost_scale (skill costs paid from HP; clamped at 0.30 LOCKED = the engine's named 'PoE1 Blood Magic guard')
traits_affixes: life-recovery / regen (the sustain that replaces mana regen)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: The engine's RS/LC lane is LITERALLY named for this kit: resource_economy.py comments hp_cost_scale 0.0..0.30 as the 'PoE1 Blood Magic guard', and reservation_resource enum includes hp. Cleanest-possible identity landing for life-as-resource. THE DRIFT: PoE Blood Magic is total and UNCAPPED — 'Removes all mana; Skills Cost Life instead of Mana; Skills Reserve Life instead of Mana; max mana = 0'; a skill can cost >30% max-HP and you can kill yourself casting. Engine hp_cost_scale is LOCKED at 0.30 (max 30% max-HP/cast) and does not zero the mana pool. So the identity (life pays for everything) lands, but the totality + the no-safety-rail DANGER that IS the Blood Magic thrill is clamped by the 0.30 guard. Keystone-not-skill => skills[] degenerate (self_buff placeholder). SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY / DEFENSIVE_TRADEOFF express the life-cost-as-build-identity capstone. Items (Malachai's, Tukohama's, Slavedriver's) dissolve to the same reservation_resource=hp lane per crosswalk §4.
